purpose: Original four-direction animated character sheets for Whisperville. Original generated PNGs copied unchanged. Grid: 3 columns, 4 rows; south, west, east, north.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL pixel-art character animation SPRITE SHEET for a top-down cozy village RPG, not a poster, not concept art. One character only: Lin Duo, friendly Chinese adult woman coffee-shop owner, short dark chestnut bob, cream shirt, terracotta apron, sage trousers, brown shoes. Cozy 16-bit farming-life RPG sensibility, original design, 2.5-heads-tall proportions, readable dark pixel outline, warm restrained palette, crisp square pixels, NO antialiasing, NO painterly textures, no photorealism.
Produce EXACTLY TWELVE separate full-body sprites in a strict THREE COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS uniform grid, on an entirely transparent background. Portrait-oriented sheet. Row 1 faces SOUTH/toward viewer; row 2 faces WEST/left; row 3 faces EAST/right; row 4 faces NORTH/back away from viewer. Each row: column 1 left-foot walking pose, column 2 neutral standing pose, column 3 right-foot walking pose. Same character, hair, outfit, scale and baseline in every cell. Full head and both feet visible in all 12 cells, each sprite centered in its own equal-sized cell, with at least 12% transparent padding on every side. No cell borders, no dividers, no lettering, no labels, no props that extend outside a cell, no scenery, no floor, no shadows, no glow, no other characters. The source sprite in each cell should look like a real hand-pixeled approximately 24x32 pixel game sprite enlarged sharply with nearest-neighbor pixels. Keep sprites SMALL AND SIMPLE, suitable for rendering at 32 to 48 pixels tall in an actual game.
